北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感 -3℃，注意防寒保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing with a felt temperature of -3℃. Stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，体感 -1℃，早晚温差大，别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny with a felt temperature of -1℃. Mind the temperature difference!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 0℃，注意添衣，别感冒了。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny with a felt temperature of 0℃. Remember to dress warmly!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感 12℃，温差大，穿搭要灵活。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Guangzhou with a felt temperature of 12℃. Dress flexibly for temperature changes.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 13℃，早晚微凉，小心着凉。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shenzhen with a felt temperature of 13℃. It's cool in the mornings and evenings.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 -1℃，有阳光也要多穿点。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny with a felt temperature of -1℃. Even with sun, dress warmly.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 -3℃，风力大，注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing with a felt temperature of -3℃ and a level 3 wind. Mind the wind chill!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，体感 5℃，小心湿冷哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu with 100% humidity and a felt temperature of 5℃. Watch out for the damp chill!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨，体感 -1℃，记得带伞，注意防湿保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Wuhan with a felt temperature of -1℃. Bring an umbrella and stay dry and warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 2℃，有点干燥，多喝水润润喉。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an with a felt temperature of 2℃. It's a bit dry, so drink more water!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 7℃，湿度较大，注意衣物防潮。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chongqing with a felt temperature of 7℃ and high humidity. Protect clothes from dampness.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴，体感 -14℃，极寒，请务必裹严实。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny with a felt temperature of -14℃. It's freezing, bundle up before going out!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感 -4℃，风大，小心风寒哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny with a felt temperature of -4℃ and a level 3 wind. Be aware of the wind chill!

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾，体感 8℃，能见度低，出行请注意安全。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Foggy in Kunming with a felt temperature of 8℃. Visibility is low, please be safe when traveling.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 5℃，风力 4级，海边风大注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xiamen with a felt temperature of 5℃ and a level 4 wind. It's windy by the sea, so mind the wind!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感 -2℃，海风阵阵，出门多穿点哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Qingdao with a felt temperature of -2℃. Sea breeze is chilly, dress warmly.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -2℃，风力 3级，注意保暖防风。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian with a felt temperature of -2℃ and a level 3 wind. Stay warm and mind the wind.
